viewsWelcome.contents:
Review pull requests with AI assistance in an editor tab.
[Open PR Pilot](command:pr-pilot.open)
Or open [Settings](command:pr-pilot.openSettings).

pr-pilot.githubBaseUrl.patternErrorMessage: Use an HTTPS origin without credentials, a port, path, query, or fragment.
pr-pilot.githubBaseUrl.description: GitHub base URL. Change for GitHub Enterprise (e.g. https://github.mycompany.com).

pr-pilot.notificationsEnabled.description: Poll GitHub in the background and notify when new matching pull requests appear. The first poll seeds existing PRs silently.

pr-pilot.notifyReviewRequested.description: When notifications are enabled, notify for new open pull requests requesting your review.

pr-pilot.notifyStarredRepos.description: When notifications are enabled, also notify for new open pull requests on your starred repositories.

pr-pilot.notificationPollMinutes.description: Background pull request notification polling interval in minutes.

pr-pilot.reviewModel.description: Review model for the Claude CLI.

enumDescriptions: Use the Copilot CLI's default routing.
Balanced default for JSON schema adherence and code review.
pr-pilot.reviewModelCopilot.description: Review model for the GitHub Copilot CLI. PR Pilot: Open Settings lists models discovered for the signed-in account.

pr-pilot.reviewProvider.description: Backend CLI used to generate reviews and chat replies.

pr-pilot.reviewEffort.description: Reasoning effort passed to `copilot --reasoning-effort`. Higher = deeper review, slower. Only applied when `pr-pilot.reviewProvider` is `copilot`. Default `high` favors catching real issues over latency.

pr-pilot.copilotInheritMcp.description: Allow Copilot to use MCP tools from your trusted Copilot config. Applies while reviewing untrusted pull request content. Servers load only from your own Copilot config (`~/.copilot/mcp-config.json`, or `pr-pilot.copilotConfigDir`); a pull request's `.mcp.json` is never loaded. Disabled by default.

pr-pilot.copilotAutoEnableMcpOnReview.description: Review-only opt-in. When enabled, Copilot review generation always enables MCP tool access even if `pr-pilot.copilotInheritMcp` is off. Chat continues to follow `pr-pilot.copilotInheritMcp`.

pr-pilot.copilotConfigDir.description: Optional override of the Copilot config directory used to discover MCP servers. Empty uses the CLI default (`~/.copilot`). Only applied when `pr-pilot.reviewProvider` is `copilot`.

pr-pilot.reviewFocusAreas.description: Default focus areas the reviewer should prioritize (e.g. `security, performance, test coverage`). Sent to the model as steering context. A per-review override in the PR Pilot view takes precedence when set.

pr-pilot.reviewCustomInstructions.description: Default extra instructions appended to every review prompt (e.g. team conventions to enforce). A per-review override in the PR Pilot view takes precedence when set.

pr-pilot.repositoryReviewInstructions.markdownDescription: Review instructions PR Pilot remembers per repository, keyed by lowercase `owner/repo`. They are added to every review of that repository, ahead of the per-review or default custom instructions. Add them from a review's instructions with **Remember for this repository**, and edit or forget them in the PR Pilot settings view.

pr-pilot.reviewGuidanceProfiles.description: Named reusable review-guidance profiles for focus areas and custom instructions.

pr-pilot.activeReviewGuidanceProfileId.description: ID of the active saved review-guidance profile. Empty uses the built-in Review defaults settings.

pr-pilot.reviewSelfCritique.description: Validate findings with a second pass that re-checks each finding against the diff and the same context the first pass saw, dropping misattributed, unsupported, and CI-duplicated ones. On by default for precision; turn it off to roughly halve review latency.

pr-pilot.reviewSupervisorEnabled.description: Re-inspect coverage gaps: run bounded coverage supervision and at most one targeted follow-up pass for changed hunks and files the first pass did not record as inspected. On by default; turn it off to save latency.

pr-pilot.reviewSecondReviewerModel.description: Optional Copilot model that reviews the same PR in parallel with the primary reviewer; its findings are cross-validated and merged. Leave blank to disable. Requires GitHub Copilot CLI and adds cost.

pr-pilot.experimentalIntellijAssistedRev.description: Experimental: show the IntelliJ-assisted review option in Advanced review options. Requires a separate IntelliJ IDEA 262+ installation, a hand-written ~/.pr-pilot/semantic-review.json, and manually importing a retained worktree per review. Off by default; ordinary reviews are unaffected. Turning this off also hides retained-worktree maintenance; turn it back on to remove retained worktrees.
